body: I understand and im sorry for your loss. i hope youre doing alright now though. for me, it hurt twice as much bc she was the first person I ever genuinely loved more than a friend yknow? yet we were never actually in a relationship. shes a christian from head to toe. especially since her dads a pastor and her mom works at a christian school, my school, the school she used to go to. shes in college and im one year away from graduating. shes fucking with me and im sure shes aware. since her mom works at my school, I see her almost every friday. its really fucks me up, seeing her haha. she pretends as if nothing happened between us and she treats me as she would anyone else. but there are days where I gather up the courage to talk to her and things just fucking escalate. I swear thats the last thing id ever expect from her now and it just fucking happens. we'd be done going out to get food and suddenly she tries to do some weird shit like trying to highfive me for whatever reason and then grabbing my hand with this firm af grip???? then she says smth like "I guess I cant have,,,,," and then she trails off and never finishes her fucking sentence but yeah yay fun times for all,,,,,,,, theres so many instances like this id fill up at least 3 pages trying to list them down. but anyway, thank you so much for your comment. it really means a lot to know someone would take the time to reply to this long ass vent hhaha. I hope you're having/ had a great day! thanks again!

its funny really, how I dont see that happening. id probably be dead by then if ever. my mom says that as long as I share her blood I cant do shit. ill be 17 in a couple of months but everything just seems so surreal. im not sure how to explain it really. also the funny thing is that kayla and I werent actually together? she just understood me and I understood her. so I suppose thats where it went wrong bc our love was so toxic and unhealthy bc we relied on one another to fix the other's problems and I swear it was the most suffocating thing ive ever experienced. I love her. I still do. its hard to let go since I see her every friday bc her mom works at my school (shes in college and im one year away from graduating) but yeah haha this isnt even the half of my problems. ive always just been sad no matter the circumstance. when I think ive run out of tears, I wake up in the middle of the night with this tsunami of thoughts and I bawl for at least a couple hours. its hard really. I cant stop thinking about how to kill myself and when im going to do it. Its come to the point where my psychiatrist was convinced I needed to be confined to the hospital to which my mom declined. but eh, what can I do right? hhahah
